messages.author: 8fb53dc026662915
messages.subject: how put shiny app including ui.R, server.R and report.Rmd on the www.shinyapps.io ???
parts:
On my computer the app is running and I could generate a pdf file, by click on download in my shiny app.
pdf creation is handle by report.rmd file. 

download related part in my server.R function is :

output$downloadReport <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() {
      paste('my-report', sep = '.', switch(
        input$format, PDF = 'pdf', HTML = 'html', Word = 'docx'
      ))
    },
    
    content = function(file) {
      src <- normalizePath('report.Rmd')
      
      # temporarily switch to the temp dir, in case you do not have write
      # permission to the current working directory
      owd <- setwd(tempdir())
      on.exit(setwd(owd))
      file.copy(src, 'report.Rmd', overwrite = TRUE)
      
      library(rmarkdown)
      out <- render('report.Rmd', switch(
        input$format,
        PDF = pdf_document(), HTML = html_document(), Word = word_document()
      ))
      file.rename(out, file)
    }
  )

and the report.Rmd is :

---
title:
classoption: landscape
header-includes: 
   \usepackage{graphicx}
   \usepackage{fancyhdr}
   \pagestyle{fancy} \fancyhf{} \addtolength{\headheight}{1.0cm} 
   \rhead{AEP report - \today}
   \usepackage{eurosym} 
   \usepackage{booktabs,xcolor}
   \setlength\headheight{28pt}
   \fancyhead[L]{\includegraphics[width=5cm]{path to logo.png}}
   \fancyfoot[LE,RO]{All rights received }
output: pdf_document
---
\ 

```{r, fig.align='center', fig.pos='htb!',out.width="700px",  echo=FALSE, cache=FALSE,warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, tidy=TRUE}
library(DT)
library(webshot)
DT::datatable(main()$AEP, options = list(dom='t',ordering=F,rowCallback = JS("function(r,d) {$(r).attr('height', '100px')}")))
 
```
 when on my Rstudio, I click publish, to put the app on shinyapps.io, the process finished without error. the app is running and show the result but the download option does not work and returns error.

I don't know how shouldI manage the report.Rmd file ?!
should I put it in separate folder like www folder ?
On local computer I use the full path to the logo that I wanna use in report.Rmd, how should I change that when it's going to be on the server ?
